stem: A clogged component can only be reached by disassembling a powered unit. Technician I is authorized only for external cleaning. What should happen?
choices: Escalate to authorized maintenance because disassembly of the powered unit exceeds Technician I's external-cleaning authority.
Unplug the unit and disassemble it because removing power makes the task equivalent to routine cleaning.
Reach the clog through the guard opening with a tool so the unit does not have to be disassembled.
Continue running the equipment intermittently in case normal flow clears the clog.
rationale: External cleaning authorization does not automatically include disassembly, guard bypass, or servicing that may involve hazardous energy. Technician I should stop at the operator-care boundary and refer the condition to personnel authorized for servicing. Simply unplugging equipment may not satisfy the facility's energy-control procedure or address stored energy.
